name: as.yaml
title: Convert an R object into a YAML string

origin.description: Turns a named list of vectors into YAML. Integers have no decimal, and each vector is a sequence under its name.
origin.usage: as.yaml(x, line.sep = "\n", indent = 2, omap = FALSE, column.major = TRUE, unicode = TRUE, precision = getOption("digits"), indent.mapping.sequence = FALSE, handlers = NULL)
origin.details: Turns a named list of vectors into YAML. Integers have no decimal, and each vector is a sequence under its name.
origin.value: as.yaml of foo = 1 through 10 and bar = test1, test2 writes each vector under its name.

translation.description: Turns a named list of vectors into YAML. Integers have no decimal, and each vector is a sequence under its name.
translation.usage: as_yaml(x, line_sep="\n", indent=2, omap=False, column_major=True, unicode=True, precision=7, indent_mapping_sequence=False, handlers=None)
translation.details: Turns a named list of vectors into YAML. Integers have no decimal, and each vector is a sequence under its name.
translation.value: as.yaml of foo = 1 through 10 and bar = test1, test2 writes each vector under its name.
translation.example:
from r_yaml import as_yaml
from r_yaml.types import Vector
print(as_yaml({"foo": Vector(list(range(1, 11)), "integer"), "bar": Vector(["test1", "test2"], "character")}))
